establishes: CCSDS SPP primary header is 6 bytes
sequence count occupies the low 14 bits of the packet sequence field
primary-header packet id and sequence fields are packed big-endian
packet length field is data length plus secondary-header length minus one
the TC packet counter is initialized to zero
the TC packet counter is incremented before packet construction
the TC packet counter wraps through the firmware counter-validation logic
secure link is enabled by default
plaintext is prefixed by a two-byte big-endian payload length and zero-padded to an AES block

semantic_correspondence.justification: The OrbitFabric operation is a parameterless request for a basic spacecraft health check. The pinned FlatSat source defines parameterless GET_STATUS/STATUS and dispatches it directly to telemetrySPPTransmitMissionStatus().
semantic_correspondence.limit: The FlatSat source does not call this operation a health check and does not establish equivalence with OrbitFabric acknowledgement, emitted-event, timeout, or expected-effect semantics. G1 claims only the bounded Story-local command projection.
semantic_correspondence.ambiguity: No ambiguity remains about the target command representation at the pinned source baseline; broader semantic/runtime equivalence is explicitly not claimed.

projection_scope: Raw CCSDS SPP telecommand bytes only; no USB, serial, RF, PWNSAT-C3 framing, transport, transmission, execution, or observation.
